_comment: Tender addenda and clarification defaults per country. Read by app/core/tender_rules.py. DEFAULT is neutral practice for any market; a country row overrides only the keys it names. Every figure carries its source and a confidence (H official or two reliable sources agree, M one reliable secondary source or settled practice). A package can override any value in its own metadata.

DEFAULT.label: Neutral practice
DEFAULT.source: Settled tendering practice; no statute fixes these figures for private works.

DE.label: Germany (VgV / VOB/A)
DE.source: Additional information must reach bidders no later than six days before the time limit, otherwise the time limit is extended; the bid validity period should normally not exceed 30 calendar days.
DE.statute_reference: VgV section 20(3); VOB/A section 10(4); Directive 2014/24/EU art. 47(3)

FR.label: France (Code de la commande publique)
FR.source: EU rule on additional information six days before the time limit, as transposed; 120 days of offer validity is common practice in tender rules (reglement de la consultation).
FR.statute_reference: Directive 2014/24/EU art. 47(3), transposed in the Code de la commande publique
